name: playwright
description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.

[Bug]: Firefox BiDi: page.title() intermittently returns an empty string after navigation
[Feature]: JUnit reporter option to add a `file` attribute to `<testcase>`
